method_scope: Original restricted one-spin finite-pulse full-XX source; scientific parameters only, no execution authorization or general algorithm proof

hamiltonian.coupling_distribution: point mass at X; no coupling RNG draw in this restricted toy
hamiltonian.interaction: (2/25) f(t) X_S X_E; retain rotating and counter-rotating transitions

frequency_quadrature.exact_nodes: omega_j=1+x_j, x_j ordered roots of P17

time_discretization.scheme: second-order free-half / full interaction at midpoint / free-half
time_discretization.ideal_vs_machine: Ideal T17 uses exact rational/free angles, exact exp interaction angles and exact GL nodes/law; stored binary64 angles,frequencies,mixture probabilities and sampled endpoint law belong to logical realization/representation reserves

randomness.frequency_draw: new independent categorical draw from all17 weights EVERY round and preparation
randomness.thermal_bath_draw: fresh Bernoulli conditioned on current omega; explicit X_E if1
randomness.preparation_vs_trajectory: Target is the average over random choices and unobserved bath discards, not a single chosen schedule/purification.
randomness.schedule_order: Each mode uses its own spawned stream; preparation-major then round-major; frequency uniform first, thermal bit uniform next; ground consumes no bit draw
randomness.categorical_rule: Use stored binary64 weights normalized by math.fsum; cumulative endpoints math.fsum(prefix)/math.fsum(weights); last endpoint=1; select first endpoint strictly greater than rng.random()
randomness.thermal_bit_rule: Use next rng.random() < stored node p1, consuming it once EVERY thermal round even when bit=0
randomness.statistical_independence_premise: PCG64 schedules are deterministic audit records; Hoeffding presumes independent complete physical/logical trial samples and independent per-round random choices, not a proof supplied by PRNG records
randomness.classical_law_representation_error: Exact ideal Q17/T17 weights/probabilities versus machine cumulative endpoints, finite uniform grid and stored probabilities require a separate full-preparation total-variation allowance

each_round: optional X E from thermal bit
